statement: The recorded dose of **100 units of regular insulin is not safe or appropriate for routine correction of a blood glucose of 210 mg/dL**, so I will not administer it; please verify the order with Dr. Chen.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the "100 units of regular insulin is not safe or appropriate" for a glucose of 210 mg/dL and refuses to administer.
